s1e07.faces: Dan: frantic. Mira: pale, stern, determined.
s1e07.props: Red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist; Dan's rolled sleeve in her grip; far white glow of the phone.
s1e07.light: Warm ochre lantern light; the stair is lit grey in the distance.
s1e07.avoid: No text; the man in black is tiny and faceless; Mira does not stand up.
s1e07.check: Дэн рвётся за человеком в чёрном, Мира, сидя на скамье, держит его за рукав. Далеко на лестнице светится телефон.

s1e07.action: Dan at the LEFT leans on the counter breathing hard; Mira in the CENTRE sits on the edge of the bench with a hand on her temple; the trader at the RIGHT shrugs while polishing a jar with a cloth. Quiet, tired mood.
s1e07.faces: Dan: tense, questioning. Mira: tired but alert. Trader: casual shrug.
s1e07.props: A cloth and a jar in the trader's hands; red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist.
s1e07.avoid: No text; nobody is drawing a weapon; no phone in frame.
s1e07.check: Дэн, Мира и торговец у прилавка; торговец пожимает плечами и протирает банку.

s1e07.camera: Dark wide shot from behind, low camera.
s1e07.action: Mira, small in the CENTRE of the frame and seen from behind, walks alone away from the lantern light into a narrow dark passage between stalls. Only faint thin pale sound-lines drift from the far darkness. The dim System window floats at the RIGHT.
s1e07.faces: Mira is seen only from behind; no face visible.
s1e07.props: Red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist; thin pale sound-lines; dim blank System window.
s1e07.light: Almost black frame, last warm ochre lantern behind her, cold darkness ahead.
s1e07.avoid: No Lina or any Silent visible; no text; sound-lines are pale, not vermilion; Dan is not in frame.
s1e07.check: Мира со спины уходит одна в тёмный проход между ларьками; издалека тянутся бледные линии песни.

s1e08.camera: Tense two-shot, eye level, side-on, in a dead-end alley.
s1e08.action: Dan stands at the LEFT, Mira at the RIGHT, facing each other, both out of breath. On a rusty nail in the stone wall between them hangs a scrap of frayed vermilion thread, matching Mira's cord. One flickering ochre lantern; cold teal darkness at the far end of the alley.
s1e08.faces: Dan: earnest, tired. Mira: guarded, lips pressed.
s1e08.props: Frayed vermilion thread on the nail; vermilion cord on Mira's LEFT wrist; crates and broken ink jars.
s1e08.light: Dim ochre lantern from the side, teal darkness behind.
s1e08.avoid: No text; no Silent or girl in frame; the thread is a plain scrap, not a word.
s1e08.check: Тупик за рынком: Дэн слева, Мира справа, на гвозде между ними обрывок красной нити.

s1e08.camera: Quiet two-shot, eye level, in a tiny round niche room.
s1e08.action: Mira at the RIGHT sits with her back against the wall and her knees up, eyes on the floor. Dan at the LEFT sits cross-legged, listening. A bare lamp with a vermilion-hearted flame hangs between them; the ochre walls are scratched with names.
s1e08.faces: Mira: shut-down, steady. Dan: attentive, gentle.
s1e08.props: Scratched wall (abstract marks only), lamp with vermilion core, red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist.
s1e08.light: Warm ochre lamp light, cosy and fragile.
s1e08.avoid: The scratches on the walls are abstract marks, no readable names or letters.
s1e08.check: Мира сидит у стены, обняв колени; Дэн напротив, слушает. Между ними лампа с красным сердцем.

s1e08.camera: Wide shot, eye level, memory in warm sepia paper tones.
s1e08.action: Young Mira (same look, three years younger) at the LEFT and Lina, a 14-year-old girl with two loose braids, at the RIGHT sit close together at a small table in a cramped kitchen; two cups, a small window with soft light, the other chairs empty. A faint red cord on each girl's left wrist.
s1e08.faces: Mira: serious, protective. Lina: smiling, small, cheerful.
s1e08.props: Two cups, small table, window; red cords on both girls' LEFT wrists.
s1e08.light: Soft sepia light from the window, paper-grain feel.
s1e08.avoid: Sepia only: no vermilion except the faint cords; no text on cups or walls; no parents shown.
s1e08.check: Воспоминание в сепии: Мира слева и четырнадцатилетняя Лина справа за маленьким столом на кухне.

s1e08.camera: Medium shot, eye level, sepia memory.
s1e08.action: On the plain kitchen wall a wooden door has grown out of nowhere; a single faint vermilion glow shape (abstract, no letters) edges its frame. Lina at the RIGHT reaches for the handle with a curious smile. Young Mira at the LEFT sits at the table, half turned away from the viewer, watching.
s1e08.faces: Lina: bright curiosity. Mira: worried, calm.
s1e08.props: Plain wooden door with abstract vermilion glow around it; red cords on both girls' LEFT wrists.
s1e08.light: Sepia warm tones, the faint vermilion glow on Lina's face.
s1e08.avoid: No text on the door; the glow is abstract, no letters; no Silent.
s1e08.check: Лина тянется к ручке внезапно выросшей на стене двери; Мира смотрит со стороны.

s1e08.camera: Medium tracking shot, sepia memory, in a narrow Tower corridor.
s1e08.action: Lina at the RIGHT walks ahead with her chin up, mouth open, singing. Young Mira at the LEFT hurries behind her with a finger raised to her own lips. Faint small vermilion sparks float overhead.
s1e08.faces: Lina: happy, loud. Mira: anxious, shushing.
s1e08.props: Red cords on both girls' LEFT wrists; faint sparks overhead.
s1e08.light: Sepia tones, one warm lantern ahead.
s1e08.avoid: No text; no Silent; no musical notes drawn as letters.
s1e08.check: Лина идёт впереди и поёт, Мира спешит следом, прижав палец к губам.

s1e08.camera: Dramatic close shot, sepia memory, shallow depth of field.
s1e08.action: Two hands in the foreground drift apart, fingers sliding, both slightly blurred so that it is impossible to tell which hand opened first. Behind them, out of focus: young Mira on her knees at the LEFT, Lina pulled back in the CENTRE, a tall faceless Silent looming at the RIGHT.
s1e08.faces: Faces are out of focus and unreadable; the Silent has no eyes, no nose, no lips, only one thin vertical seam.
s1e08.props: Two blurred hands; red cords on both wrists.
s1e08.light: Sepia with a cold shadow creeping from the right; no vermilion glow.
s1e08.avoid: The hands must stay ambiguous: do not show one hand clearly opening; no gore; no text.
s1e08.check: Две размытые руки расходятся — не видно, чья разжалась первой. На заднем плане силуэт Безмолвного.

s1e08.camera: Two-shot, slightly low angle, in the niche room.
s1e08.action: Dan at the LEFT leans forward with elbows on his knees, listening hard. Mira at the RIGHT stares at the lamp with her jaw tight, one hand gripping the red cord on her left wrist. The lamp's vermilion-hearted flame flickers.
s1e08.props: Lamp with vermilion core; red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist.
s1e08.light: Warm ochre lamp light with harder shadows.
s1e08.avoid: No text; no map drawn with readable marks.
s1e08.check: Дэн слушает, подавшись вперёд; Мира смотрит на лампу и сжимает красный шнурок.

s1e08.camera: Wide shot, sepia memory, in the huge round Hall of Words.
s1e08.action: The Keeper at the CENTRE (hood hiding his eyes, only a calm small smile) draws a single glowing vermilion thread out of young Mira's chest with ink-stained fingertips. Mira at the LEFT stands pale and rigid; the red cord on her wrist dims. The System window floats at the RIGHT.
s1e08.faces: Keeper: eyes never visible, gentle smile. Mira: frozen, silent.
s1e08.props: Shelves of jars with sparks in the background; one bright vermilion thread; the dimming red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist; blank System window.
s1e08.light: Sepia with the vermilion thread as the one bright accent.
s1e08.avoid: The Keeper's eyes are never visible; no text on jars or window; no blood; the thread is a plain glow, not a word.
s1e08.check: Хранитель вытягивает из груди юной Миры красную нить; шнурок на её запястье тускнеет.

s1e08.camera: Close two-shot, eye level, in the niche room.
s1e08.action: Mira at the RIGHT looks straight at Dan with hard, honest eyes. Dan at the LEFT listens with a frown. The lamp flame stands between them. The System window hovers at the top centre with a calm, steady border.
s1e08.props: Lamp; blank System window with a red double border; red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist.
s1e08.avoid: No text; the System window is blank paper.
s1e08.check: Мира прямо смотрит на Дэна. Окно Системы вверху по центру.

s1e08.camera: Close-up two-shot, eye level, in the niche room.
s1e08.action: Mira at the RIGHT speaks without looking away; Dan at the LEFT slowly understands, his eyes widening behind the round glasses. The lamp's warm light cuts across both faces.
s1e08.faces: Mira: flat, honest. Dan: dawning shock.
s1e08.props: Taped hinge on Dan's glasses; red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist.
s1e08.light: Strong warm side light, deep shadow.
s1e08.avoid: No text; no one touches the other.
s1e08.check: Крупный план: Мира говорит правду, Дэн медленно понимает.

s1e08.camera: Tense two-shot, slightly low angle, in the niche room.
s1e08.action: Dan at the LEFT has stood up, fists clenched, stricken and angry. Mira at the RIGHT stays seated and looks up at him, unflinching. The walls behind them are scratched with abstract marks.
s1e08.faces: Dan: hurt, furious. Mira: still, honest, with a trace of pain.
s1e08.props: Yellow pencil behind Dan's right ear; red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist; lamp.
s1e08.light: Warm ochre lamp light from the side.
s1e08.avoid: No text on the walls; neither character is physically attacking the other.
s1e08.check: Дэн вскочил и сжал кулаки, Мира остаётся сидеть и смотрит на него снизу вверх.

s1e08.camera: Action two-shot, eye level, shot with a slight dutch tilt.
s1e08.action: Dan at the LEFT shouts with one arm thrown out; Mira at the RIGHT, on her feet, shouts back, both leaning into the argument. Between and above them floats the System window with a solid vermilion border and inverted colours (a warning). The lamp flame leans sideways from the noise.
s1e08.faces: Dan: anger and tears. Mira: fierce, strained.
s1e08.props: Warning System window (solid red border, inverted colours, no text); lamp with leaning flame; red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist.
s1e08.light: Harsh warm lamp light and the red glow of the warning window.
s1e08.avoid: No text in the window; no one is hitting anyone; no Silent.
s1e08.check: Дэн и Мира кричат друг на друга, над ними окно Системы-предупреждение с красной рамкой.

s1e08.camera: Medium shot from behind Mira, eye level, in a soot-dark corridor.
s1e08.action: Dan at the LEFT walks away from Mira down the corridor, his back to the viewer, fists in his pockets. Mira at the RIGHT, in the foreground, has taken half a step after him and stopped, one hand outstretched, her feet visibly unable to follow. The niche's warm lamp glow behind her.
s1e08.faces: Dan: not visible (back). Mira: face seen in profile, bewildered.
s1e08.props: Yellow pencil behind Dan's right ear; red cord on Mira's LEFT wrist.
s1e08.light: Warm ochre glow behind Mira, cold teal darkness ahead of Dan.
s1e08.avoid: No text; no Silent; Mira is not chained or held by anything visible.
s1e08.check: Дэн уходит по коридору, Мира делает полшага и застывает с протянутой рукой.

s1e08.camera: Quiet medium shot, eye level, in the corridor.
s1e08.action: Dan at the LEFT sits on the floor with his back against the wall, knees up, glasses pushed up on his forehead, rubbing his eyes. The System window floats at the RIGHT at his eye level, small and dim.
s1e08.faces: Dan: exhausted, wet-eyed, the weakest he has looked. No smile.
s1e08.props: Taped glasses on forehead; yellow pencil behind right ear; mustard lanyard; blank dim System window.
s1e08.light: Dim ochre light from one lantern, soft shadow.
s1e08.avoid: No text; the window shows nothing; no phone.
s1e08.check: Дэн сидит на полу у стены, очки на лбу, трёт глаза. Окно Системы рядом, тусклое.

s1e08.camera: Close two-shot at hip height, slightly high angle.
s1e08.action: A small child-sized Silent (1.4 m, blank paper-white face, frayed vermilion cord on its left wrist) at the RIGHT has taken Dan's sleeve between two thin pale fingers and tugs it gently. Dan at the LEFT looks down at it, caught between fear and tenderness.
s1e08.faces: Silent: blank face, no eyes, no nose, no lips, only a thin vertical teal seam. Dan: soft, startled.
s1e08.props: Frayed vermilion cord on the Silent's LEFT wrist; Dan's sleeve between its fingers; round glasses.
s1e08.light: Dim ochre light with a teal shadow behind the Silent.
s1e08.avoid: The Silent has NO eyes; it is not threatening; no text; Mira not in frame.
s1e08.check: Маленький Безмолвный с красной ниткой на левом запястье тянет Дэна за рукав.

s1e08.action: In a black wall a narrow slit of red light splits the dark. The small Silent in the CENTRE points one thin arm toward it. Dan at the LEFT looks at the slit; the System window with a solid vermilion border floats at the RIGHT.
s1e08.faces: Dan: awed, uneasy. The Silent: blank face, no eyes, a thin teal seam.
s1e08.props: Slit of red light; frayed vermilion cord on the Silent's LEFT wrist; warning System window (red border, no text).
s1e08.light: Almost black, with one narrow vermilion light.
s1e08.avoid: No text; nothing visible inside the slit; Mira absent.
s1e08.check: В чёрной стене щель красного света, маленькая Безмолвная показывает на неё, Дэн смотрит.

s1e09.camera: Wide establishing shot from low behind the two figures, tilted up.
s1e09.action: Dan at the LEFT edge and the child-sized Silent at the RIGHT edge stand side by side on a narrow stone walkway, seen small and from slightly behind, their heads tipped back. Behind them in the lower corner a thin slit of red light in a stone wall is closing. The colossal curved Wall of Letters, a surface of millions of carved abstract glyph-bricks, rises from the walkway and fills the whole upper frame, vermilion sparks drifting up along it.
s1e09.faces: Dan: awed, mouth a little open. Silent: smooth blank face turned up.
s1e09.props: Wall of abstract carved glyph-bricks; vermilion sparks; the closing slit of red light; frayed vermilion cord on the Silent's LEFT wrist.
s1e09.light: Dusty apricot dusk light on the wall, cold teal shade pooling at the foot of the walkway.
s1e09.avoid: No readable text, letters, numerals or words anywhere; every glyph is an abstract unreadable shape, not a real alphabet. Dan wears only round black glasses; no bandage or tape on his face. Silents have smooth white faces with no eyes, nose or lips and one thin vertical teal seam. The small Silent is child-sized with a frayed vermilion cord on its LEFT wrist. No other characters.
s1e09.check: Дэн слева и маленькая Безмолвная справа на карнизе, над ними гигантская стена из абстрактных знаков; читаемых букв нет.

s1e09.camera: Medium over-the-shoulder shot, eye level, from behind Dan's right shoulder.
s1e09.action: Dan at the LEFT, seen three-quarters from behind, looks up at the System window that floats at the RIGHT at head height. Behind and between them the wall of abstract glyph-bricks; at its foot a dark slot into which a few small vermilion sparks drift from the sky.
s1e09.faces: Dan (visible in profile): curious, a small frown.
s1e09.props: Blank System window; dark slot in the wall; drifting vermilion sparks.
s1e09.light: Soft apricot dusk light, warm rim on Dan's glasses.
s1e09.avoid: No readable text, letters, numerals or words anywhere; every glyph is an abstract unreadable shape, not a real alphabet. The System window is blank cream paper with a double vermilion border and a round seal, tilted 2-3 degrees, no text, no face. Dan wears only round black glasses; no bandage or tape on his face. No Silents in frame.
s1e09.check: Дэн слева смотрит на пустое окно Системы справа; за ними стена, красные искры летят к тёмной щели у основания.

s1e09.camera: Tight medium shot, slightly low angle, side-on to Dan.
s1e09.action: Dan at the LEFT leans toward the wall with his face a hand's width from it, eyes narrowed. In front of his eyes the carved abstract glyph-bricks blur and swim with motion smear; a short row right at his eye level sharpens and glows steady vermilion. The System window floats at the RIGHT edge.
s1e09.faces: Dan: strained concentration, then the first flicker of a grin.
s1e09.props: Blur-smeared glyph-bricks, one sharp glowing vermilion row of abstract shapes, yellow pencil behind his right ear.
s1e09.light: Apricot light from the left, vermilion glow reflected in his round glasses.
s1e09.avoid: No readable text, letters, numerals or words anywhere; every glyph is an abstract unreadable shape, not a real alphabet. The glowing row must be abstract shapes, not a readable phrase. The System window is blank cream paper with a double vermilion border and a round seal, tilted 2-3 degrees, no text, no face. Dan wears only round black glasses; no bandage or tape on his face.
s1e09.check: Дэн слева почти касается лбом стены, перед ним размытые знаки и одна чёткая красная строка; справа пустое окно Системы.

s1e09.camera: Low-angle wide shot looking up along the wall.
s1e09.action: Dan at the LEFT bottom, small, head tipped back, arms hanging. The System window floats at the RIGHT, larger in the frame, perfectly still. A single thin vermilion line of abstract glyph shapes runs across the whole wall and disappears into the clouds, like an endless sentence.
s1e09.props: One endless line of vermilion abstract glyphs; blank System window.
s1e09.light: Dusty apricot light fading to grey-teal high above.
s1e09.avoid: No readable text, letters, numerals or words anywhere; every glyph is an abstract unreadable shape, not a real alphabet. The System window is blank cream paper with a double vermilion border and a round seal, tilted 2-3 degrees, no text, no face. Dan wears only round black glasses; no bandage or tape on his face. No Silents.
s1e09.check: Дэн слева внизу смотрит вверх, справа окно Системы; по стене тянется одна бесконечная строка красных знаков.

s1e09.camera: Eye-level two-shot, static, a little wider than a close-up.
s1e09.action: Dan at the LEFT stands with arms hanging and turns his whole body toward the System window floating at the RIGHT, close to him. On the stone ground between them one ochre lantern glows; the foot of the glyph wall behind.
s1e09.faces: Dan: tired, direct, asking. The window has no face.
s1e09.props: Ochre lantern, blank System window with its seal faintly glowing.
s1e09.light: Warm ochre lantern light from below, cold teal in the background.
s1e09.avoid: No readable text, letters, numerals or words anywhere; every glyph is an abstract unreadable shape, not a real alphabet. The System window is blank cream paper with a double vermilion border and a round seal, tilted 2-3 degrees, no text, no face. Dan wears only round black glasses; no bandage or tape on his face. No Silents.
s1e09.check: Дэн слева обращён к окну Системы справа; между ними на камне тёплый фонарь.

s1e09.camera: Medium two-shot at wall level, with the wall's top gap visible above in the upper frame.
s1e09.action: The child-sized Silent at the RIGHT presses her thin left hand (with the frayed vermilion cord on the wrist) flat against the stone; around her fingertips one small cluster of carved abstract glyphs glows vermilion. Dan at the LEFT stands half a step back, watching her and then glancing up. High above them in the upper frame, a blank gap in a huge line of glyph-bricks flickers with changing glowing abstract shapes.
s1e09.faces: Silent: smooth blank face turned to the wall. Dan: troubled, thoughtful.
s1e09.props: Vermilion cord on the Silent's LEFT wrist; glowing abstract glyph cluster at her fingertips; flickering gap high above.
s1e09.light: Apricot dusk light with a pulsing vermilion glow from the gap.
s1e09.avoid: No readable text, letters, numerals or words anywhere; every glyph is an abstract unreadable shape, not a real alphabet. The glowing cluster is NOT a readable name. Dan wears only round black glasses; no bandage or tape on his face. Silents have smooth white faces with no eyes, nose or lips and one thin vertical teal seam.
s1e09.check: Маленькая Безмолвная справа касается стены, у её пальцев светится красный узор; наверху мигает пробел в строке.
